caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical wooden container with an open top, above which is a separate, matching circular lid suspended in the air. The container is constructed of vertical wooden slats in shades of light tan, cream, beige, and brown, with a black metal band encircling the bottom for reinforcement. It has a wooden handle attached to the top sides with black metal or wire fasteners. On the side of the container, there is a rectangular painted panel featuring a group of different fruits, including yellow pears, a pink peach, clusters of purple grapes, greenish bananas, and several reddish fruits. The lid, which matches the color and construction of the container, has a similar tan hue and visible joinery. The background is a plain, off-white or light tan color, and there are no additional objects or background elements in the drawing.
title: Wooden Jam Pail
